name: Command Knights
does: Order your Guards: tap = order at what you look at, hold = draw a line, Shift + key = back to posts.

name: Command Archers
does: Order your Archers: tap = target or spot, hold = draw a line, Shift + key = back to posts.

name: Command Spearmen
does: Order your Spearmen: tap = target or spot, hold = draw a line, Shift + key = back to posts.

name: Command Longswordsmen
does: Order your Longswordsmen: tap, hold to draw a line, Shift + key to send them back.

name: Command Rune Mages
does: Order your Rune Mages: tap, hold to draw a line, Shift + key to send them back.

name: Command Healers
does: Order your Healers: tap, hold to draw a line, Shift + key to send them back.

name: Command all soldiers
does: Order every soldier at once, the same way as the role keys.

name: Orders strip (hold fire, follow, back to posts)
does: Open the orders strip: hold fire / fire at will, all follow me, all back to posts (keys 1-3).

name: Summon the settler you look at
does: Look at any settler and press to call them to you.

name: Finish (separate key; unbound uses Command Knights)
does: Execute a glowing, staggered enemy. While unbound, the Command Knights key (R) does it.

name: Open the Handbook
does: Open the Handbook at the page a recent hint pointed to, or the last page you read.
